services.description:
Services include install and styling. Hair not included

Traditional Sew in: Standard sew-in with small leave-out (2 fingers width for part line) and
minimal edge leave-out. 

Versatile/Vixen Sew In: This install requires significantly more time than a traditional sew-in
due to perimeter leave-out, detailed track placement and blending for
updos (buns, ponytails). The extra detailing is what creates the
seamless finish. 

Closure/Frontal Sew in: This includes install + lace piece application, customization + blending
of lace. No leave-out.

No leave out/Flip over method: This method requires detailed tiny track placement, illusion of hairline, styling for flip and movement.
